tips.text: Run Void Armageddon solo or with a premade squad to reach Rotation C; public squads usually leave before round 3.
Interact with the targeted Exodamper to Provoke Assault and start the next wave early, then kill the enemies fast.
Keep one player near the Eternal Relic; once the Angel dies, leftover enemies beeline to it and can fail the run.
Skip Armageddon for Thrax Plasm or relics; it has no Thrax and no Void Fissures, so farm Plasm in Cascade, Flood or Exterminate.
Use Madurai or Unairu with a hitscan amp on the Angel's Void form, and avoid damage-conversion amp arcanes.
Bring Frost, Limbo, Gara or Nyx to shield the Relic and the Exodampers.
Take the Handle in the Cascade runs you already do for Zariman fissures, Narin parts or Entropic Kuva.
The Blade is the slow part; every Armageddon rotation pays it now, so it hurts far less than older threads say.
